from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    a = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1100, "height": 700})
    b = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1100, "height": 700})
    for page in (a, b):
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:3100')
        page.wait_for_selector('.editor-line:nth-child(1223)')
    a.locator('#editor').click(position={"x": 180, "y": 12})
    a.keyboard.type('A')
    a.locator('#save-button').click()
    a.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('#revision-state').textContent.includes('2')")
    b.locator('#editor').click(position={"x": 180, "y": 12})
    b.keyboard.type('B')
    b.locator('#save-button').click()
    b.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('#save-state').textContent === 'Conflict'")
    assert 'newer saved revision' in b.locator('#message').text_content()
    assert b.locator('#save-state').text_content() == 'Conflict'
    print('two-tab stale save visibly refused; newer content preserved')
    browser.close()
